verdict.rationale: Statsig documents product analytics through Metrics Explorer and switchable chart types, but nothing in the evidence mentions funnel charts, multi-step conversion analysis, filters, breakdowns, or drop-off identification. General analytics charting is an adjacent feature and does not count as funnel support, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off
